data.name: PRM_CannotRegisterTwice
data.value: PageRequestManager は複数回初期化できません。
data.comment: The PageRequestManager cannot be initialized more than once.

data.name: PRM_MissingPanel
data.value: ID '{0}' の UpdatePanel が見つかりません。動的に更新する場合は、別の UpdatePanel 内に配置する必要があります。
data.comment: Could not find UpdatePanel with ID '{0}'. If it is being updated dynamically then it must be inside another UpdatePanel.

data.comment: The message received from the server could not be parsed.

data.comment: An unknown error occurred while processing the request on the server. The status code returned from the server was: {0}

data.name: PRM_TimeoutError
